name: Password Generator
tagline: Strong random passwords and memorable passphrases, made on your device.
description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases with a clear strength rating. Made on your device, never sent or stored anywhere.

specs.Look-alikes: l, I, O, 0 and 1 left out unless you ask

faq.q: Is the password sent or saved anywhere?
faq.a: No. It's made in this tab from your device's secure random number generator and is never stored or sent. The page's security policy blocks any outside connection.
A passphrase of five or six random words is easier to remember and type, and just as hard to guess as a long jumble. Use a password manager for the rest.
